lastText: Command TerminatedThe Coalition Withdraws ConfidenceMajor DefeatAllied Combined Chiefs, 1940–1945End of hostilities: CONFIDENCE WITHDRAWN · filed out of sequence, pages missingImmediate AftermathThis campaign ends here, and not on any battlefield. █████████ Cohesion has run out, not a ██████ ally's objection, but the accumulated weight of every unilateral gambit this command █████ it on, past the point the alliance could still function ██████. Washington and London do not announce a dismissal; supreme command in a coalition war doesn't work by dismissal, it works by a phone call that stops returning your authority to act. The war continues under whichever ██████████ the Combined Chiefs can still agree on without you in the room. It was never yours to run alone: every choice in this campaign that spent cohesion was, in effect, a bet that it briefly could be. This is what happens when that bet is called too many times.One Year LaterThe war ends under whichever compromise the Combined Chiefs settled on ███████ this command in the room. A year on, the history of that final year gets written by whoever was actually present for it: supreme Allied command in a coalition war is, in the end, a chair, and the chair's occupant by V-E Day is not who occupied it when this file was opened.The Theater Map at the end of the warThe map at the end of 1945StartCONFIDENCE WITHDRAWN: The war endsLatestDenmarkBritainIrelandFranceBeneluxSwitz.IberiaGermanyPolandCzechiaAustriaHungaryBalticsLeningrad
